limitations: Every source-pool repository has an outcome; only eligible inventoried repositories have file rows. This is not all GitHub.
Includes nonregular entries and large files as metadata; downloader must apply its eligibility/size policy.
Git SHA-1/SHA-256 object IDs are binary and retain their algorithm; whole-file SHA-256 is assigned after hydration.
Repository-level license does not resolve file-level overrides.
